Update or Append a Class Teacher

Source: R/manual_class_list_functions.R
update_class_teacher.Rd

Updates or appends a teacher to a specified class within a school.

Class identification preferentially uses `class_name`, falling back to `c_wonde_name` when `class_name` is unavailable.

Usage

update_class_teacher(
  data,
  class_name,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  new_name = paste(first_name, last_name),
  ...,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A class-list data frame using configured or internal column names.

class_name

Class or classes to edit. NA edits all classes within the selected school.

first_name

Teacher first name.

last_name

Teacher last name.

new_name

Teacher full name. Defaults to the concatenation of `first_name` and `last_name`.

...

Exactly one named school identifier, using an internal lookup key or configured external name, e.g. `URN = 123456`, `EST_ID = '001'`, or `est_wonde_id = 'A123'`.

overwrite

If TRUE, update existing teacher information. If FALSE, append copies of matching rows with the new teacher.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, reports the number of rows updated or appended.

Value

The updated class list with configured column names.
